_about: The owner's own recordings (docs/voice-clips-to-record.md), to settle whisper base.en vs small.en. Same shape as clips.json; copy this over clips.json in a scratch work dir whose clips/ folder holds the converted <id>.wav files (compare.py only synthesizes clips when that folder is missing). 'say' is what is read aloud; 'ref' is the reference transcript (fillers like 'um' left out); 'terms' are the names, numbers and domain words that must come through (alternatives separated by |, correct spellings and number forms only); 'command' is the command word(s) the transcript must start with (§4.1 safe-to-type rule).
